correctness.rationale: For all d>=2, 1<=k<=d, all fixed observed responses b and deterministic starts, unit regular-simplex Gram spectrum gives A^T A=(d+1)/d I and ker A^T=span{1}. A size-k block has Gram eigenvalue (d-k+1)/d along its ones vector. Thus the forcing z_S=delta d/(d-k+1) sum_{i in S}a_i lies in the selected row span and is pointwise orthogonal to Q_S e. Permutation invariance and rank give E Q_S=(1-k/d)I; E z_S=0 and E z_S z_S^T=delta^2 k/(d-k+1)I. The conditional Pythagorean recurrence yields exactly E||e_t||^2=(1-k/d)^t||e_0||^2+delta^2 d^2(1-(1-k/d)^t)/(d-k+1); the centered-start covariance equals delta^2 d(1-(1-k/d)^t)/(d-k+1) I. Checks include k=d (alpha=0), delta=0 and t=0. Independent rational projector/shift calculations for all subsets for d=2..5 and all k agree; they corroborate rather than replace the all-d proof.
